jobs.title: Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
About Aldar Hospitality 
 Powered by human connections and the desire to reimagine guest experiences, every destination within our hospitality portfolio is transformed to reflect the human spirit: nurturing, ever evolving and wholesome. Our diverse portfolio of assets ranges from hotels and island resorts to golf clubs, marinas, and iconic beach clubs. Our footprint in the local and international hospitality landscape is growing and we are on a mission to turn ordinary moments into lifelong memories through offering unforgettable guest experiences. Aldar Hospitality is the subsidiary of Aldar Properties PJSC, the leading real estate developer and manager in the UAE. Come and join us on this journey. 

 About the Role 
 This is an opportunity for a seasoned Manager – FP&A to join our team. In this capacity, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis and management reporting across the Aldar Hospitality portfolio.
 You will provide an independent, forward-looking view of financial performance, challenge property and operator assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and translate financial data into clear recommendations for Executive Management and the Board.
 You will also drive the transformation of FP&A through artificial intelligence, automation and advanced analytics, materially improving the speed, accuracy and value of planning, forecasting and reporting processes.

 Responsibilities 
 Financial Planning and Forecasting 
 Drive the annual budget, rolling forecast and five-year planning processes alongside the Corporate Director of Finance
 Review and challenge property forecasts across revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, payroll, operating costs and CAPEX.
 Develop scenario and sensitivity analysis to support management decisions.
 Track forecast accuracy and improve the quality and consistency of financial submissions.
 Performance Management 
 Lead the monthly review of property financial performance.
 Identify the underlying drivers of variances, risks and opportunities.
 Recommend and track actions to improve EBITDA, cash flow and operating performance.
 Executive and Board Reporting 
 Prepare concise monthly performance reporting for Executive Management.
 Develop the financial narrative for Board, budget and Aldar Group reporting.

jobs.description:
Ideally located in the heart of Sharjah, voco Sharjah offers easy access to Sharjah International Airport, SAIF Zone, and the city's key business and commercial districts. The hotel prime location provides convenient connectivity to Dubai, Ajman, and Sharjah's most popular attractions.

The hotel is perfectly positioned near some of Sharjah's most renowned educational and cultural institutions, including the University of Sharjah and the American University of Sharjah, making it an excellent choice for visiting academics, students, families, and corporate travelers. Guests are also within easy reach of University Hospital Sharjah, and the vibrant Aljada community.

Designed with voco's signature charm and thoughtful hospitality, the hotel features stylish guest rooms and suites, a fully equipped fitness centre, an inviting outdoor swimming pool, versatile meeting and event facilities, and a selection of dining experiences, including an all-day dining restaurant, cozy café, and lobby lounge. Whether the stay is for a short visit or an extended stay, voco Sharjah delivers a warm, trendy comfortable, and memorable experience.

Bottom line? We’re looking for a new Finance & Business Support Manager comfortable with balancing the books when it comes to managing the needs of owners, auditors and regulatory agencies while also monitoring and improving hotel profitability. In return, we’ll put our financial operations and the security of our hotel assets in your expert hands.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

 Lead the Finance & Business Support team and provide strategic financial guidance to the hotel leadership team.
 Drive the annual budget, business plan, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes.
 Deliver accurate monthly financial statements, management reports, and business performance analysis.
 Monitor hotel performance through financial and operational KPIs, identifying risks and opportunities to improve profitability.
 Ensure compliance with IHG policies, accounting standards, local tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
 Oversee the hotel's accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and cash management.
 Strengthen financial controls, governance, and risk management practices to protect company assets.
 Partner with department heads to support commercial decisions, cost control initiatives, and operational improvements.
 Lead the month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accuracy and timely reporting.
 Manage internal and external audits, ensuring all findings are addressed promptly.
 Review contracts, procurement activities, and supplier agreements to ensure financial compliance and value for the business.
 Drive process improvements, digital initiatives, and efficiencies across finance and business support functions.
 Coach, develop, and inspire the Finance team, creating a high-performing and collaborative culture.
 Act as a trusted business partner to the General Manager, providing commercial insight to support strategic decision-making.
 Champion ethical business practices while ensuring full compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

 What We need from you:

 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. A professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CIMA, CA, or equivalent) is preferred.
 A minimum of 5 to 7 years of progressive finance experience, including leadership experience within the hospitality industry.
 Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business decisions.
 Solid knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial controls.
 Experience leading high-performing finance teams and developing talent.
 Strong understanding of accounting standards, tax regulations, and audit requirements.
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
 Experience working with hotel finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
 Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all levels.
 A collaborative leadership style with a passion for driving business performance and continuous improvement.

 What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager – UAE Accounting, Tax & Treasury 
 Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

 Job Purpose 
 The Country Finance Manager will take end-to-end responsibility for the finance and accounting activities of the company’s UAE operations.
 This is a hands-on role covering financial accounting and reporting, UAE tax and statutory compliance, treasury and cash management, banking, financial controls, budgeting and audit coordination. The role will act as the principal finance contact for the UAE entity and work closely with Group Finance, local management and external professional advisers.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage day-to-day accounting activities and monthly, quarterly and year-end closing, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, expenses, bank reconciliations, accruals, provisions and fixed assets.
 Prepare accurate financial statements, management reports, budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections and variance analyses in accordance with IFRS, applicable UAE requirements and Group accounting policies.
 Manage UAE Corporate Tax and VAT compliance and, where applicable, Excise Tax, including registration, calculations, filings, payments, reconciliations, record keeping and correspondence with the Federal Tax Authority.
 Coordinate customs duties, import VAT, transfer-pricing and related-party compliance where relevant to the company’s operations.
 Oversee inventory accounting, product costing, landed-cost calculations, stock reconciliations and inventory provisions.
 Manage treasury and banking activities, including liquidity planning, payment scheduling, working-capital monitoring, foreign-exchange exposure, bank-account administration and KYC documentation.
 Coordinate intercompany settlements, cross-border fund transfers and funding arrangements with Group Finance, ensuring appropriate approvals and supporting documentation.
 Establish and maintain appropriate financial controls, approval procedures, payment controls and segregation-of-duties arrangements to safeguard company funds and assets.
 Coordinate payroll accounting and salary-payment processes, including applicable WPS requirements, in cooperation with HR and external payroll providers.
 Liaise with external auditors, tax advisers, banks and other professional service providers to complete statutory audits, tax filings and other finance-related regulatory requirements.
 Monitor relevant UAE regulatory developments and support the implementation of accounting systems, finance processes and applicable e-invoicing requirements.
 Undertake other finance, tax, treasury and business-support assignments as required.

 Qualifications and Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
 A recognised professional accounting qualification, such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CMA or CA, is strongly preferred.
 At least seven years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including substantial hands-on experience in the UAE and experience at Finance Manager, Financial Controller or an equivalent level.
 Proven ability to independently manage the end-to-end finance function of a UAE-based company, subsidiary or business unit.
 Strong practical knowledge of UAE Corporate Tax, VAT, Federal Tax Authority procedures and the EmaraTax platform.
 Knowledge of Excise Tax, customs duties, import VAT and designated-zone requirements is required or strongly preferred where relevant to the company’s products and operating model.
 Strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, closing processes, audit coordination, budgeting and internal financial controls.
 Hands-on experience in cash-flow forecasting, banking operations, intercompany settlements and cross-border funding arrangements.
 Experience in inventory accounting, product costing and working-capital management within a product-based, distribution or trading business.
 Previous audit, tax or advisory experience with a recognised accounting or professional services firm would be an advantage.
 Proficiency in ERP or accounting systems and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
 Able to work independently in a hands-on environment, manage multiple priorities and communicate effectively with local stakeholders and overseas headquarters.
 Full professional proficiency in English is required. Chinese or Arabic language capability would be an advantage but not mandatory.

 About PAX(Hayati®) 
 PAX, established in 2021 and headquartered in Hong Kong, operates globally. As a world-leading consumer electronics company, we focus on cutting-edge technologies.

 Hayati®, PAX’s flagship brand, was born in the UK and has since grown into one of Britain’s best-known consumer electronics brands, with a strong and expanding international presence. Alongside Hayati®, we continue to incubate and develop a diverse portfolio of brands—including Quokka®, Moxy®, Liora®, Finebar® and Philia®—each designed for different lifestyles, moments and markets around the world.

 In 2025, PAX completed a pre-IPO reorganisation of its corporate structure and governance framework, entering the preparation phase for a potential NASDAQ listing. PAX Group Holdings Limited leads the Group’s global governance and long-term strategy, with operating offices across the UK, Germany and the UAE to support local markets worldwide. The Group’s exclusive Chinese mainland partner, PAX Innovations (Shenzhen) Limited, provides integrated R&D, branding, supply chain and quality management services, connecting our global brands with world-class manufacturing capabilities.

 Guided by integrity as our core value, PAX is driven by innovation, centred on users, and committed to building for the long term and sustainable development. By combining dependable products with trusted partnerships, we work alongside consumers, partners, and the broader industry to shape a credible, future-oriented global ecosystem.

jobs.title: Inventory Controller - Logistics
jobs.description:
About Us 
 As a leader in luxury retail in the Middle East, Al Tayer Group's retail division, Al Tayer Insignia, hosts a portfolio of some of the world’s best luxury brands in the fashion, jewellery, home and department store categories. Complementing its position in luxury retail, Al Tayer Insignia has also built new frontiers in lifestyle retail, representing leading brands in the Beauty, Home, Fashion and Hospitality sectors. Our brands include Bloomingdales, Harvey Nichols and Armani to name just a few!
 Job Purpose 
 
To manage & monitor the inventory and stock holdings ensuring system stock issues are minimized. Monitor and control movement of stock, formulate policies and control procedures in order to maintain minimum discrepancies. Ensure all returns to suppliers are managed & monitored.
 
 Strategic Roles and Responsibilities 
 Custodian of Business inventory and responsible for overall inventory management operations.
 Responsible for warehouse storage space optimization, ABC analysis, heat map analysis and implementation
 Implement stock loss action plans (formulated as a result of cycle counts/stock counts) in conjunction with Loss Prevention Team
 Review and monitor extent of damages in the WH and come up with action plan to mitigate the occurrence in conjunction with warehouse inbound and outbound operations
 Execution on WH shrinkage analysis and reductions.
 Ensure timeliness & integrity of all inventory transaction
 
 Functional Roles and Responsibilities 
 Conduct investigation of inventory discrepancies identified during cycle count or picking and take action to rectify the discrepancies within the timelines.
 Oversee the entire process of stock transfers inter warehouse, warehouse to store and store to warehouse, ensure the movements are recorded and updated to reduce discrepancies.
 Provide regular update on pending transfers, WH cycle counts & transparency of trouble coded inventory
 Directly coordinate with suppliers and buying for returning the intended stocks
 Tracking on all WH logs, credit note, RTV adjustments and submit to FSS
 Pass the CN, RTV, Write-off and general adjustment thru system and report to finance.
 Monitor transactions daily, investigating discrepancies and confirming On-base logs are raised. Also reviewing the status of logs to ensure accurate resolution.
 Manage perpetual stock take calendar in conjunction with designated managers and stock take team, communicate the plan, and ensure compliance to the plan.
 Liaise with business inventory managers for monthly shrinkage data and prepare/share the final report.
 Manage the expiry product identification and share the visibility reports with all stakeholders.
 Manage the disposal or RTV of expired and obsolete goods at respective warehouse to ensure high quality standards are maintained in the activities of the Company. 
 Oversee the physical stock count process, review stock count results in conjunction with the management and reconcile the figures by auditing physical stock movements.
 Prepare reports based on the findings and provide recommendations and suggestions to the management
 
 People Management Roles and Responsibilities 
 Coach and motivate reportees to enhance performance and produce quality standards and outputs, ensure that they are continuously developed and provided feedback.
 Review Operational processes from a risk management perspective; identify and qualify new areas of risks and escalate concerns to the site HSE committee.
 Guide and motivate subordinates to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously developed for higher level roles.
 Maintain HSE practices in the working environment in order to minimize the opportunity of damage property and injury to self and colleagues. Pro-actively remind colleagues to behave in line with the HSE processes defined by the company
 Regularly communicate to the team on operational performance and brief on upcoming events
 Create a positive work environment that results in low attrition, sickness and absence reduction to ensure that Collective and individual targets are met
 
 Education/Certification and Continued Education 
 Graduate with excellent knowledge of warehousing & inventory management
 
 Years of Experience 
 3-5 years of experience in warehousing & inventory management with knowledge in ecommerce retail environment
 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Computer Literacy and excellent MS excel skills 
 Highly organized with eye for details
 Preferably Good knowledge in Oracle - WMS 
 Strong Communication and Interpersonal skills 
 Good analytical skills
 
 Languages 
 English

jobs.title: Business Solutions Manager - Data Science & AI Projects (Revenue Management)
jobs.normalized_title: business solutions manager data science & ai projects revenue management
jobs.description:
Turn data science into real-world commercial decisions. 
 We’re looking for a hands-on Data Science and AI professional to join Etihad’s Solutions & Innovation team and help build the next generation of analytical solutions supporting our Revenue Management function.
 This isn’t a role where you’ll simply analyze data and make recommendations.
 You’ll take ownership of data science and machine-learning projects from idea to production – defining the problem, developing the model, building and testing proof-of-concepts, deploying solutions and continuously improving their performance.
 One of your key areas of focus will be the continued development of Etihad’s in-house ancillary dynamic pricing capability , applying data science and machine learning to help make smarter, more responsive commercial decisions at scale.
 You’ll also have the opportunity to identify and build entirely new solutions as Etihad continues to expand the use of advanced analytics, automation and AI across Revenue Management.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead data science, machine-learning and AI projects from ideation and model development through POC, deployment and productionization.
 Develop and enhance machine-learning models supporting dynamic pricing, forecasting, optimization and commercial decision-making.
 Play a key role in evolving our in-house ancillary dynamic pricing capability.
 Identify new opportunities to apply AI, machine learning and advanced analytics to real Revenue Management and commercial challenges.
 Build new analytical products while continuously improving existing models and solutions.
 Test, validate, calibrate and monitor models to ensure they continue to deliver measurable business value.
 Partner with Revenue Management, Digital, Technology & Innovation and Commercial teams to turn complex business problems into scalable technical solutions.
 Translate sophisticated analytical outputs into clear commercial insights that stakeholders can understand and act upon.
 Help move successful prototypes beyond experimentation and into robust, production-ready solutions.
 Support adoption and change, ensuring new solutions become embedded in commercial decision-making.
 Extensive experience in leading the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of dynamic ancillary pricing capabilities to maximize ancillary revenue while enhancing customer value and conversion
 Identify, evaluate, and implement Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning use cases to improve operational efficiency, revenue generation, and customer experience
 Promote the adoption of AI-driven insights and automation across commercial processes to support innovation and continuous improvement
 Why this role? 
 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, AI and commercial aviation .
 Rather than developing models that remain experimental, you’ll see your work translated into solutions used to support real commercial decisions across Etihad. You’ll inherit existing products to improve, including our ancillary dynamic pricing capability, while also having the opportunity to develop new solutions from the ground up.
 As Etihad continues its growth under Journey 2030, you’ll be joining a team focused on using technology, advanced analytics and innovation to rethink how commercial decisions are made.
 If you’re a data scientist who wants to move beyond experimentation and build solutions that make it all the way into production, we’d like to hear from you.

What we’re looking for 
 You’ll bring a strong combination of hands-on data science capability and project leadership . You should be equally comfortable getting into the technical detail of a model and working with business stakeholders to understand the commercial problem you’re trying to solve.
 Ideally, you’ll have:
 A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Technology or another relevant quantitative discipline.
 5+ years’ experience across data science, machine learning, AI or advanced analytics.
 Strong hands-on experience building machine-learning models and taking them through the complete lifecycle into production.
 Strong Python and/or R capability and experience working with modern data science tools and platforms.
 Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable analytical solutions.
 Exposure to platforms such as Databricks and cloud environments including GCP, Azure or AWS.
 Strong project leadership and stakeholder management capability.
 The ability to explain complex technical concepts and model outputs in commercially meaningful terms.
 Knowledge of Revenue Management, pricing, forecasting or optimization would be highly valuable.
 Airline or travel industry experience would be strongly preferred, but we’re open to candidates who can demonstrate strong data science capability and the ability to apply it to complex commercial problems.

Recruitment Process 
 The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps:
 Applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team
 Shortlisted applicants will be invited to completed a recorded video interview via our third-party platform HireVue. This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to. It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses. 
 After a review of completed video interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager.
 Finalists may be invited to a follow up interview. This interview will involve the completion and presentation of relevant business case.
 All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.
 
 Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

Synopsis
 The Global Account Manager (GAM), Travel Management Company (TMC) is responsible for leading Etihad’s commercial strategy, account development and growth across our global travel management partners.
 This role will manage and develop a defined global portfolio of TMC partners, acting as a point of contact on accountability for commercial performance, contracting, strategic engagement and growth.

The role requires deep understanding of the operational and commercial nuances of the TMC segment, including high level of negotiating skill, strong analytical background, will have worked with TMC on marketing and able drive business growth, will work cross-functionally with Pricing, Revenue Management, Marketing, Distribution, and Network to unlock revenue, grow share, and ensure competitive positioning in this high-potential vertical.
 Accountabilities
 Own the global commercial relationship with TMC partners, serving as one of the central points of contact for all strategic and operational engagement.
 Drive revenue growth, develop and execute a global TMC sales strategy, focus on strategic partnerships and seeking new opportunities that are aligned to Etihad’s revenue goals, network priorities, and key embarkation markets. 
 Lead the contracting and negotiation process, including fare programs, override structures, incentive setups, to ensure Etihad’s number one position.
 Collaborate with Sales Products and Programs, Sales Steering, and Revenue Management colleagues to ensure the global TMC segment is competitive, flexible, and aligned to revenue targets while protecting our share.
 Identify tactical sales opportunities, including working with the regions across the network to ensure our position as a strategic partner with the global TMCs.
 Monitor and track performance at a global and regional level, leveraging Salesforce, and custom internal databases and dashboards to identify growth opportunities, underperformance, or account risk.
 Facilitate global commercial alignment, ensuring regional sales teams and GSA partners are coordinated and supported in their management of global TMCs
 Lead QBRs and performance reviews with TMCs, presenting actionable insights and securing buy-in for future growth strategies.
 Act as the internal subject matter expert for the global TMC segments, advising network planning, route development, and new station setup teams on market dynamics and sales opportunity.
 Represent Etihad at key trade events, conferences, and industry summits relevant to the TMC sectors.

Education & Experience
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Aviation, Tourism or related fields required; Master’s preferred
 7-10 years’ experience in B2B sales or account management, preferably in aviation, marine travel, or global mobility
 Strong understanding of the TMC / corporate travel ecosystem, seasonality, negotiation and contracting models
 Demonstrated success in managing strategic accounts across multiple markets and functions
 Skilled negotiator with strong commercial analytical acumen and marketing experience
 Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills
 CRM fluency (Salesforce preferred), with strong Excel and analytical skills
 Willingness to travel internationally as required

Open to International candidates, relocation package is provided. 
 
 Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com

We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

 Ready for the challenge?

 Monitor global tax developments and ensure Etihad remains compliant and prepared for change.

 Notes

 In Silal, our mandate is to diversify food sources and stimulate manufacturing and distribution in the agri-food sector in the UAE and beyond. As a part of ADQ, one of the region's largest holding companies, Silal is emerging as one of the sector’s leading and most ambitious players.

 Position Overview 
 Manager – Finance is responsible for Managing Silal’s daily accounting operations and transactions and ensure that all journal entries and ledger balances are accurate and correctly recorded. This includes maintaining internal accounting controls and ensuring compliance with financial policies and regulations.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 Key Responsibilities as Manager – Finance will include the following:
 Manage the daily accounting records and ensure that all journal entries are completed on a timely basis to support period/year end closing (i.e., adjusting entries, accruals and reconciliation)
 Ensure that all Silal’s transactions comply with financial regulations, monitor accounting data on a regular basis and recommend improvements where necessary
 Manage the trial balance analysis process at the end of accounting periods, ensure that all accounting entries are correctly recorded and that all ledger balances are accurately extracted to support in drafting and generating financial statements
 Maintain internal accounting controls by establishing a chart of accounts and by defining and enforcing accounting policies and procedures across Silal in order to sustain financial security
 Ensure adequate and periodic maintenance of the chart of accounts
 Identify and recommend improvements to the monthly closing process and recommend changes/improvements to increase effectiveness and efficiency
 Manage the maintenance and update of Silal’s General Ledger accounts
 Manage the maintenance of Silal’s inventory related activities such as transfers and inventory count and ensure compliance with the inventory and warehouse policies and regulations
 Manage the closing process monthly, quarterly and annually
 Prepare monthly and Year End Financial reports, coordinate external audit review
 Review vendor invoices, supporting documents and journal entry in liaison with contracts and procurement and as per policies and procedures
 Manage payroll processing activities and end of service payments and maintain records while ensuring that calculations are properly reviewed in close collaboration with the HR department
 Manage insurance policies, capitalization and insurance claims of fixed assets as per policies and procedures while ensuring that entries and ledgers are updated accordingly
 Prepare and file VAT return.

 In order to be successful in this role, you should have
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
 Masters’ degree is preferable
 Professional certification such as CPA/CFA or equivalent is preferable
 Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, with 4 years in a managerial position.

jobs.description:
Synopsis
 As Product Specialist – Cargo Digital Systems, you will support the delivery, enhancement, and day-to-day evolution of Etihad Cargo’s digital platforms and commercial systems ecosystem, with a strong focus on the Cargo Booking Website, API integrations, and internally developed digital applications.
 You will work closely with Product Owners, Cargo business stakeholders, DT&I, vendors, and development teams to gather requirements, define solutions, coordinate deliveries, perform testing activities, and support continuous product improvements.
 The role combines product analysis, business process understanding, technical coordination, and hands-on support for digital product development initiatives. You will contribute to Agile product delivery while supporting the development and enhancement of web applications built primarily using JavaScript and React technologies.
 This role is ideal for candidates with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities who are interested in developing broader technical, digital product, and application development skills.
 Accountabilities
 • Prioritize and coordinate the delivery of bug fixes, enhancements, and new releases for Cargo systems in collaboration with DT&I and Cargo stakeholders across Commercial and Operations.

• Support the delivery of enhancements, fixes, integrations, and new features across Etihad Cargo digital platforms and Cargo systems.

• Act as a key contributor for the Etihad Cargo Booking Website, supporting feature enhancements, business requirements gathering, testing activities, and coordination with vendors and developers.

• Support integration projects between Cargo systems, customer platforms, and third-party applications.

• Assist in the design, coordination, and delivery of small internal applications, automation tools, and operational support solutions.

• Gather and document business requirements from Commercial, Revenue Management, Pricing, Sales, Operations, Customs, and Ground Handling stakeholders.

• Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

• Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.

• Coordinate closely with DT&I teams, vendors, and developers to ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood.

 The Medical Core System Transformation Lead is responsible for end‑to‑end delivery of the health insurer’s core medical system modernization , including policy administration, claims, benefits, provider management, and clinical integrations. 

 This role owns the business-led transformation of legacy medical systems into a modern, scalable, compliant, and digital-first platform that enables operational efficiency, better member and provider experience, regulatory compliance, and future AI/analytics capabilities. 

 What you will do 

 1. Transformation Leadership 

 Lead the strategy, design, and execution of the medical core system transformation program. 

 Act as the single point of accountability for business outcomes, timeline, and value realization. 

 Translate enterprise strategy into a clear transformation roadmap (phased migration, MVPs, decommissioning).

 Own transformation across key medical domains, including: 

 Claims adjudication and payment 

 Policy & benefits configuration 

 Provider and network management 

 Authorizations and utilization management 

 Medical pricing, rules, and payment logic

 Partner with Medical, Operations, Finance, Actuarial, Compliance, and Provider Relations teams. 

 Ensure business rules, clinical workflows, and regulatory requirements are accurately digitized . 

 Resolve trade-offs between standard product capability vs. local customization.

 Lead engagement with core system vendors, system integrators, and niche solution providers . 

 Oversee solution design, deployment quality, and contractual commitments. 

 Govern vendor delivery to ensure alignment with architecture, security, and compliance standards. 

 5. Governance & Delivery Execution

 Manage multi-workstream delivery (technology, data, business readiness, migration, change). 

 Ensure transformation is delivered with minimal disruption to ongoing business operations. 

 6. Regulatory & Compliance Readiness 

 Ensure core systems meet health insurance regulatory, payer, and data privacy requirements . 

 Support audits, reporting, and compliance validation through system design and controls. 

 7. Change, Adoption & Value Realization

 Define and track value realization metrics (speed, cost, accuracy, scalability). 

 Enable future capabilities such as analytics, automation, and AI-driven operations.

 Essential Experience 

 12+ years of experience in health insurance, payer operations, or healthcare technology . 

 Proven leadership of large-scale core system transformation programs in medical insurance. 

 Deep understanding of medical claims, benefits, pricing, provider networks, and utilization management . 

 Experience modernizing legacy medical core platforms to modern or SaaS-based solutions. 

 Technical & Domain Expertise 

 Strong knowledge of health insurance core systems (claims/PAS/medical modules). 

 Experience with system migration, data conversion, and parallel run strategies . 

 Understanding of API-based integration, interoperability, and data architecture . 

 Comfort working with enterprise architects, security, and data teams. 

 Leadership & Ways of Working 

 Strong stakeholder management across business, clinical, technology, and vendors . 

 Ability to lead through ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs. 

 Executive-level communication and decision facilitation skills. 

 Outcome-oriented mindset with strong delivery discipline. 

 What equips you for the role 

 Core medical system migration delivered on time and within agreed scope . 

 Reduction in claims processing time, errors, and manual interventions. 

 Improved configurability of medical benefits and pricing. 

 Measurable improvement in member and provider experience. 

 Safe decommissioning of legacy platforms and technical debt reduction

 Orient Insurance Company commenced operations in 1982 as a part of the reputed Al-Futtaim Group and has since recorded a progressively steady growth. The Company is counted among the leaders in the UAE insurance market. Orient Insurance Company has a paid-up capital of AED 500 Million which is the highest in the insurance industry in UAE. With head office in Dubai, the company serves its clientele through an extensive branch network in Jebel Ali, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah in UAE, Muscat in Sultanate of Oman, Riyadh in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.

 Role Purpose 

 The Risk Manager supports the CRO in maintaining an independent and effective enterprise risk management function. The role identifies, assesses, monitors and reports material risks, promotes sound risk culture, and protects policyholders, solvency and the Company’s regulatory standing. 

 Regulatory Context 

 The role shall comply with applicable UAE insurance laws and CBUAE requirements, including the Risk Management and Internal Controls Regulation, related Standards and the Corporate Governance Regulation. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Maintain the enterprise risk management framework, policies, risk taxonomy, risk register and committee governance. 

 Support the Company in setting risk appetite, limits and key risk indicators; monitor exposures and promptly escalate breaches. 

 Provide independent challenge on strategy, business plans, products, pricing, underwriting, claims, reserving, reinsurance, investments, outsourcing, technology and major projects. 

 Assess all material risks, including insurance, credit, market, liquidity, operational, conduct, regulatory, cyber, model, climate, concentration and emerging risks.

 Conduct stress, scenario and reverse-stress testing; report vulnerabilities and monitor management actions.

 Maintain records of risk events, losses, near misses and control failures; oversee root-cause analysis and action closure. 

 Support accurate regulatory submissions and supervisory reviews. 

 Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into policies, controls and implementation actions. 

 Review control effectiveness and ensure risk acceptance is properly authorised and documented. 

 Coordinate with Compliance, Actuarial and Internal Audit while preserving each function’s independence. 

 Maintain complete and auditable risk records, models, assumptions and decisions. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in risk management, actuarial science, finance, accounting, insurance or a related field; relevant postgraduate or professional qualification is preferred.

jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing  

As a Treasury Specialist, you will play a key role in managing daily treasury operations, ensuring accurate liquidity monitoring, forecasting, and reporting.

The role contributes to treasury optimization initiatives, coordinates with banks, and supports internal stakeholders with treasury-related matters.

This position requires analytical skills, strong coordination, and knowledge of treasury processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Cash Management, Forecasting and Reporting:

  • Monitor daily Group cash positions and liquidity across banking partners.

  • Consolidate cash balances and prepare daily liquidity reports.

  • Prepare short-, medium-, and long-term cash flow forecasts in collaboration with Finance .

  • Develop treasury dashboards, KPIs, and management reports.

  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end treasury reporting.

  • Support implementation of best practices in cash management.

SAP S/4HANA & Treasury Systems:

  • Support treasury processes within SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Risk Management.

  • Maintain cash management structures, bank account master data, and liquidity reporting configurations.

  • Support system testing, enhancements, and treasury process improvements.

  • Collaborate on SAP upgrades and treasury transformation initiatives.

Credit Facilities & Banking:

  • Monitor Group credit facilities, utilization levels, and available headroom.

  • Track financial covenant compliance and support periodic covenant reporting.

  • Prepare reports on debt maturities, facility utilization, and financing metrics.

  • Liaise with banks and internal stakeholders on treasury-related matters.

Controls, Governance & Compliance:

  • Ensure compliance with Treasury Policies, Delegation of Authority, and internal procedures.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation for treasury activities.

  • Support internal and external audits.

  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of treasury data and reporting.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with Accounting and Finance on treasury reporting, reconciliations, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Support business stakeholders with treasury-related queries and reporting requirements.

  • Provide treasury insights and analysis to support management decision-making.

What you’ll need to succeed  

  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field Experience.
    You possess 3 to 5 years of experience in Corporate Treasury, Cash Management, Banking or Financial Planning.

  • You preferably have experience with SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Cash Management.

  • You preferably have experience with Treasury Management System.

  • You have a knowledge of Power BI or other reporting tools.

You have a solid understanding of cash management, liquidity forecasting, banking products, credit facilities, and treasury processes.

You are an effective communicator.

What we can offer you  

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.  We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.  

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.  

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

 Notify Team Lead of changes in roles and responsibilities promptly.

 Conduct peer review of petty cash payments.

 Match balance confirmation with claims in SAP bi-annually and annually.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - IT Internal Audit
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 
• Assist in executing the annual IT Audit Plan under the supervision of the line manager
• Assist in risk assessment, executing end to end IT Audit, and special assignments
 
Please note, this role is for a UAE national only

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Internal Audit organization set-up:

• Ensure compliance to the approved Internal Audit (IA) processes, policies and procedures during the execution of audit engagements
• Support line manager in administrative tasks such as periodic updates to management, organizing department files, and meetings etc.

Monitoring and reporting:

• Draft the Risk Assessment and Control Matrix for performing the audit engagement to ensure engagement deliverables meet the audit scope and objectives
• Participate in creating, reviewing and finalizing the internal audit engagements and reports ensuring that all engagement terms of • reference have been adequately responded to and are adequately documented
• Assist the line manager in gathering the data for preparing presentations/ materials for submission to the head of Internal Audit/ higher management where applicable

Audit execution:
• Conduct initial research on the subject matter to be audited to identify potential risks and controls
• Assist with audit kickoff meetings to discuss the scope (process review) with the concerned department(s)
• Identify the key processes in conjunction with the department 
• Develop the process flow of the current process the “As Is” to identify technology risk points and validate available controls
• Perform control design testing documentation and operating effectiveness testing
• Draft detailed report and executive summary for Line Manager’s review and final discussion with the department
• Conduct a follow-up the following year of the engagement on assess the status of action plans and submit the follow-up report
 
 
QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE

RELATED YEAR OF EXPERIENCE:
• 4-6 years of experience in IT Audit

FIELD OF EXPERIENCE:
• Big 4 Consulting or equivalent. Oracle and Salesforce audit experience is a plus

TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
• Primary - Excellent in IT Audit procedures and analyzing internal control gaps for IT General Controls and Application Controls
• Secondary - Cybersecurity audit, Data analytics
• High proficiency in presentation and reporting skills is a must

QUALIFICATION
•   Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, engineering or Information Systems/ Technology
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) certification or equivalent

jobs.normalized_title: head of enterprise it finance hr and group functions
jobs.description:
Synopsis
 Etihad Airways is seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise IT to lead the delivery of a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation across Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, and other enterprise functions.
 The role will be responsible for defining the transformation strategy, leading implementation partners, managing programme governance, and ensuring successful business adoption. The successful candidate will bring deep SAP expertise, enterprise programme leadership experience, and a proven track record delivering complex transformation initiatives in large organizations.
 Accountabilities
 Lead the end-to-end delivery of the SAP S/4HANA transformation programme across Finance, Procurement, HR, and related business functions.
 Develop and execute the ERP transformation roadmap aligned with business and digital transformation objectives.
 Overall responsible for Agile and waterfall projects.
 Establish programme governance, budget controls, risk management, and benefits realization frameworks.
 Partner with Finance, Procurement, HR, and Technology stakeholders to design future-state business processes and technology solutions.
 Drive process standardization and optimization enabled by SAP S/4HANA.
 Manage System Integrators, consulting partners, vendors, and delivery teams.
 Oversee programme delivery across design, build, testing, data migration, cutover, deployment, and hypercare phases.
 Ensure integration between SAP and enterprise applications, operational platforms, and third-party systems.
 Lead business readiness, change management, training, and adoption activities.
 Provide regular executive reporting, steering committee updates, and programme governance oversight.
 Ensure compliance with governance, audit, security, and regulatory requirements.
 Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation capabilities to improve business processes and ERP outcomes.

Education & Experience
 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
 MBA or Master's degree preferred.
 Minimum 15 years of experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
 Minimum 8 years of SAP programme delivery experience, including at least one full SAP S/4HANA implementation.
 Proven experience leading Finance, Procurement, and HR transformation initiatives.
 Strong experience managing large implementation budgets, external vendors, and system integrators.
 Strong delivery record across both Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.
 Extensive experience managing executive stakeholders, programme governance, and organizational change.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.
